name: HABITAT FOR HUMANITY OF GREATER
mission: SEEKING TO PUT GOD'S LOVE INTO ACTION, HABITAT FOR HUMANITY BRINGS PEOPLE TOGETHER TO BUILD HOMES, COMMUNITIES AND HOPE TO REALIZE OUR VISION OF A WORLD WHERE EVERYONE HAS A DECENT PLACE TO LIVE. HABITAT FOR HUMANITY OF GREATER GREENSBORO ADHERES TO A STRICT NON-PROSELYTIZING POLICY AND WILL NOT BASE AN OFFER OF ASSISTANCE ON THE EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED CONDITION THAT PEOPLE ADHERE TO OR CONVERT TO A PARTICULAR FAITH OR LISTEN AND RESPOND TO MESSAGING DESIGNED TO INDUCE CONVERSION TO A PARTICULAR FAITH.
activity_or_mission: PROVIDE ACCESS TO HOMEOWNERSHIP OPPORTUNITIES FOR HOUSEHOLDS EARNING BETWEEN 30-80% OF THE AREA MEDIAN INCOME. BY PROVIDING INCREASED HOMEOWNERSHIP ACCESS, HABITAT GREENSBORO ASSISTS IN BUILDING AND STRENGTHENING OUR COMMUNITY.
programs:
1. [4a] HOMEOWNERSHIP PROGRAM: FAMILIES, IN NEED OF A DECENT PLACE TO LIVE, BUILD SAFE AND AFFORDABLE HOMES IN PARTNERSHIP WITH HABITAT. HABITAT HOMES ARE MODESTLY SIZED - LARGE ENOUGH FOR THE HOMEOWNER FAMILY'S NEEDS, BUT SMALL ENOUGH TO KEEP CONSTRUCTION AND MAINTENANCE COSTS AFFORDABLE. BY USING THE LABOR OF VOLUNTEERS AND PROSPECTIVE HOMEOWNERS, EMPLOYING EFFICIENT BUILDING METHODS, KEEPING HOUSE SIZES MODEST, AND USING DONATED CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS AND APPLIANCES, HABITAT MAKES ITS HOUSES AFFORDABLE FOR LOW-INCOME FAMILIES TO PURCHASE. AFFORDABLE HOMEOWNERSHIP HELPS CREATE THE CONDITIONS THAT FREE FAMILIES FROM INSTABILITY, STRESS, AND FEAR AND ENCOURAGE SELF-RELIANCE AND CONFIDENCE. STUDIES SHOW THAT STRONG AND STABLE HOUSEHOLDS ARE FOUNDATIONAL TO CHILD DEVELOPMENT AND GROWTH. WHEN A HOME FOSTERS - INSTEAD OF HINDERS - HEALTH AND SAFETY, FAMILIES CAN FLOURISH. OWNING AN AFFORDABLE HOME ALSO ALLOWS HOMEOWNERS TO LIFT UP THEIR ENTIRE FAMILY BY SAVING FOR THEIR FUTURES AND INVESTING IN EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITIES, BOLSTERING JOB OPPORTUNITIES AND CAREER GROWTH. DURING FISCAL YEAR 2024, HABITAT GREENSBORO SERVED 16 HOUSEHOLDS THROUGH ITS LONG-TERM HOMEOWNERSHIP PROGRAM. (expenses $4,047,477)
2. [4b] RESTORE SERVICES: THE RESTORE WAS CLOSED ON MAY 4, 2024. HABITAT GREENSBORO'S RESTORE EXISTS TO PROVIDE REVENUE TO SUPPORT THE AFFORDABLE HOMEOWNERSHIP MISSION AND TO PROVIDE HOME FURNISHINGS, APPLIANCES, BUILDING MATERIALS, AND OTHER ITEMS TO THE PUBLIC AT A SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCED COST. BUSINESSES AND INDIVIDUALS DONATE NEW AND USED ITEMS TO THE STORE. HOMEOWNERS AND OTHERS VOLUNTEER IN THE STORE, KEEPING THE OPERATING EXPENSES AS LOW AS POSSIBLE. (expenses $844,291)
3. [4c] FINANCIAL AND HOMEBUYER EDUCATION PROGRAM: AS PART OF THE HOMEOWNERSHIP PROCESS, WE BELIEVE FINANCIAL EDUCATION BUILDS A MORE SOLID FOUNDATION FOR LONG-TERM PERSONAL SUCCESS AND HELPS ALLEVIATE ANY CONCERNS OR BARRIERS ON THE PATH TO HOMEOWNERSHIP. DURING THESE FINANCIAL EDUCATION CLASSES, COVERED TOPICS INCLUDE BUDGETING; CREDIT CARDS AND CREDIT REPORTS; DEBT AND LOANS; SAVING, INVESTING AND PLANNING FOR THE FUTURE; EMERGENCY SITUATIONS; AND HABITAT HOMEOWNER MORTGAGES. A MORE IN-DEPTH UNDERSTANDING OF THESE IMPORTANT CONCEPTS IS A TOOL THAT CAN BE USED TO BUILD A BETTER FUTURE. (expenses $441,831)

name: Yancey CountyBurnsville Chamber of Commerce
mission: Empowering members through education, advocacy, and partnership.
activity_or_mission: The mission of the Burnsville-Yancey County Chamber of Commerce is empowering members through education, advocacy, and partnership.
programs:
1. [4a] Business Builders Breakfasts: The Yancey County Chamber of Commerces Business Builders Breakfasts are a monthly networking and educational event designed to support local businesses. Co-sponsored by Mayland Community Colleges Small Business Center and the Yancey Chamber, the events feature speakers discussing timely community issues affecting the community. Education sessions are included on pertinent topics such as corporate development and taxes. Attendees benefit from a pre-program networking opportunity, fostering connections and business relationships building among local professionals. (expenses $451,989)
2. [4b] Yancey Chamber After Hours: The Yancey County Chamber of Commerces Business After Hours are premier networking gatherings held at various local businesses througout the county. These events offer Chamber members and local professionals the opportunity to connect, collaborate, and build relationships in a relaxed, after-work setting. Attendees also enjoy refreshments, explore host venues, and engage in meaningful conversations that foster community and business growth. Each event showcases a different local business, providing insights into their operations and contribtuions to the community. With ten events hosted annually, Business After Hours serves as a cornerstone for professional networking and community engagement in Yancey County. Leadership Yancey: Leadership Yancey County is a seven-month leadership development program organized by the Yancey County Chamber of Commerce. Through monthly sessions, participants explore key sectors such as education, industry, health, and human services, small business, tourism, parks and recreation, agriculture, and local government. The program includes site visits and interactive learning experiences designed to deepen understanding of the countys assets and challenges. With a $200 fee covering meals, transportation, and material, Leadership Yancey equips emerging leaders with the knowledge and connections needed to shape the communitys future.
3. [4c] Remote Workers Exchange: The Yancey County Chamber of Commerces Remote Worker Exchange events provide a welcoming space for remote professionals to connect, socialize, and expand the business community in Yancey County. Hosted at the local Chamber-member venues, these gatherings offer a relaxed atmosphere with beverages and appetizers, encouraging attendees to forget meaningful relationships and support local businesses. Sponsored by the Chamber of Commerce and Yancey County Economic Development, the initiative strengthens ties between remote workers and the broader business community, fostering collaboration and economic growth in the region.
